race.comment: SHOTARO (1) resumes from a spell that would have done him the world of good after showing talent over ground as a 3YO last season. He has been tuned up with 3 jump-outs, winning the latest of those narrowly at Cranbourne, and can kick things off this prep on a winning note. GIANT'S REPRIEVE (2) is a lightly tried 5YO gelding with plenty of natural talent. He caught the eye late when finishing third fresh up at Albury 3 weeks ago, and despite copping another tough gate, he can nab a win in a race like this. BOTTAS (8) charged late, and was only beaten by a nose when resuming from a spell at Wagga, and then had not much go his way last time out at Wangaratta when left exposed, finishing fourth. He can get the run to suit him this time from the pole position, and should be fighting out the finish this time. STAR BUYER (6) is another with top 4 claims.
